adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the exact case where fallback should apply), the `.find(...)` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`), so it will almost always return `undefined`, losing the previous fallback to the event’s destination calendar externalId. The same pattern is used in `deleteEvent` (`calendarId`), so legacy references without `externalCalendarId` will no longer target the destination calendar and will likely default/behave incorrectly.
